entities.summary: Bangladesh is a sovereign nation in South Asia, Asia. Its capital is Dhaka. Official languages include Bengali (Bangla). Government: Unitary parliamentary republic (interim government since August 2024). Population: approximately 173.0 million. Area: 147,570 km². Comprehensive index for Bangladesh covering ancient Vanga and Pundra kingdoms, Mauryan-Gupta integration, Pala dynasty Buddhist golden age, Sena dynasty, Delhi Sultanate and independent Bengal Sultanate, Mughal Bengal (richest province), British Raj (Bengal Presidency), Partition 1947 (East Pakistan), Language Movement 1952, Six Points, 1971 Liberation War/genocide, Mujib era, military coups, Ershad/Zia/Khaleda/Hasina political dynasties, garment industry revolution, and climate vulnerability.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Bangladesh's 1971 Liberation War and genocide led to the deaths of an estimated 300,000 people and resulted in the country becoming a sovereign nation. The event had significant regional implications, shaping the modern history of South Asia.
